title: ExploreCraft: Tweaks
description: A collection of tweaks and utilities for the ExploreCraft modpacks.
body:
# ExploreCraft: Tweaks

A collection of tweaks and additions for the [ExploreCraft Modpack](https://explorecraft.net).

## Additions

Currently, the Tweaks addon for ExploreCraft: Rekindled adds the following:
- Donuts
- Advanced Netherite Upgrades (craftable with a Diamond Upgrade Frame, also added by the mod)
- The Core (a currently WIP item that will have a use later on)
